articles.summary: As the 33rd Annual Painting Project Nears, First Mid Employees Recount the Events Lasting Impact Burlington, IA (September 1, 2026) For more than three decades, Paint-A-Thon volunteers, sponsors, and community members have witnessed firsthand what a home can mean to people. As First Mid Bank Trust (First Mid) prepares to participate in this years Paint-A-Thon in Burlington, IA, longtime volunteers within the bank are reflecting on the lasting impact this community effort has had on homeowners and volunteers alike. Paint-A-Thon, which will kick off September 7, is a volunteer-led home improvement project that helps improve the appearance and value of qualifying homes throughout Burlington. First Mid is proud to continue the longstanding support of the event established by Two Rivers Bank Trust, with local team members carrying forward a tradition many have been part of for years. Since the event started 33 years ago, nearly 600 homes have been painted. Eric
articles.title: First Mid Bank & Trust Prepares for Annual Paint-A-Thon Event

articles.summary: 30th annual survey projects an average yield of 212.39 bushels per acre across the county Bloomington, IL (September 2, 2026) First Mid Ag Services has released the results of its 30th Annual McLean County Corn Yield Estimate, projecting an average yield of 212.39 bushels per acre. Ten First Mid Farm Managers collected 1,570 samples from 157 locations on managed farms in every township across McLean County. Estimated yields ranged from 153.75 to 268.80 bushels per acre. Key Findings Below the five-year average: The estimated yield of 212.39 bushels per acre is below McLean Countys five-year average of 230.02. Most sampled locations above 200 bushels: 71% of sampled locations were estimated above 200 bushels per acre. Weather constrained kernel development: Excessive June rainfall followed by July heat and drier conditions limited kernel development and fill.
